title: Aagaye dashte karbala
body:
baqae la ilaah hussain hai
farmane mustafa hai ye qaule rasool hai
hussaino minni wa ana minal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
awwalona mohamed ausatona mohamed
aakhirona mohamed kullona mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
aagaye dashte karbala mein ye saare mohamed
kaho salaam ya rasulluah
ye dashte karbala hai ye dashte maarya hai
ye dashte nainawa hai
mohamed haye mohamed
mohamed haye mohamed
suno faryad mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnalabon ke lab pe sada wa mohameda
ghayre hue hai fauje jafa wa mohameda
sar pe khadi hai sheh ke qaza wa mohameda
dikhla raha hai waqt ye kya wa mohameda
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hui zameen pe hai laasha hussain ka
be-gor o be-kafan hai janaza hussain ka
koi nahi hai poochne waala hussain ka
qaidi banaya jaata hai kunba hussain ka
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor choor hai sajda hussain ka
jism o sare hussain pade hai juda juda
dooba hua hai khoon mein sehra e karbala
laashe shahe zaman pe hai ghurbat ka marsiya
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadmon pe sadme khaate hai sarwar bachaiye
toote hue hai naiza o khanjar bachaiye
umran hua hai shaah pe lashkar bachaiye
zainab nikal na aaye khule sar bachaiye
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
badta hi ja raha hai masayib ka silsila
ab to nahi hai qaime mein abbas e bawafa
dete hai cheekh cheekh ke ye ahle shar sada
ab loot lo qayaam hussain e ghareeb ka
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pukarti hai yehi roke baar baar
maajaye tujhpe khahare khasta jigar nisar
aankhon ke saamne hai ye manzar jigar figaar
tanha behan hai aur bhare ghar ki soghwaar
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
halqe shahe ghareeb pe khanjar bhi chal gaya
baad e rasool kaise zamana badal gaya
qaima nabi ki aal ka karbal mein jal gaya
bano ka chand dashte musibat mein dhal gaya
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein panjetan ki nishani tamam hai
qismat mein ab aseeron ke bas gham ki shaam hai
ro'o ay momino ye buka ka maqam hai
bedi rasan hai tauq hai laagar imam hai
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha dayam o yazdan yehi zainab ka marsiya
maqtal mein bekafan hai janaza hussain ka
zakmon se choor choor hai zehra ka dilruba
rote thay sar ko peet ke sultan e ambiya
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
author: Dayam Najafi
